_notes.volume: This app keeps its only copy of state (data/harness.db and, later, uploaded documents under data/files) on disk inside the container, so it needs a Railway Volume mounted at /app/data. Create the volume in the Railway dashboard for this service and set its mount path to /app/data before the first deploy, or the database is wiped on every redeploy.
_notes.singleInstance: numReplicas must stay at 1. node:sqlite in this app supports exactly one writer process; scaling this service to more than one replica while it uses SQLite will corrupt or silently drop writes.
_notes.secrets: Set SESSION_SECRET (32+ random hex characters, e.g. `openssl rand -hex 32`) as a Railway service variable, never in this file. Leave OUTBOUND_SEND_ENABLED and GRAPH_CAPTURE_ENABLED at 0 and HARNESS_NO_LOGIN unset, same as deploy/fly.toml.
_notes.healthcheck: /login is public (see proxy.ts) so the healthcheck passes whether or not anyone is signed in; it only confirms the app answers HTTP requests.
